tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Sakhalin Taimen adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the simplified nonhumanoid animal prop; no human hands/arms/legs/eyebrows/lips or new large eyes. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 GREET: A connected existing forelimb/wing/fin gently raised in a small friendly greeting, same supported or floating body stance. Species constraints: 人の腕・脚を追加しない。ヒゲ・斑・横帯・背鰭・尾の二叉形や非対称形を各原画どおり保つ。地面・水面・泡を追加しない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL: exactly ONE clean full fish in the center, with wide alpha-zero margins on all four sides. Absolutely no disconnected brown fragments, no cropped second animal, no marks or text at image edges. Preserve the original visible fin count: one dorsal fin plus small adipose, one near pectoral fin and two bottom fins plus the single forked tail; gently lift ONLY the connected existing near pectoral fin for greeting, do not keep a duplicate resting pectoral. Empty canvas truly transparent.
